html:
Unique Research · Insight / industry monthly · March 27, 2023 · Full rewrite — not a stub · Data: adtarg 2023-02-01→02-28; Amazon/BestBuy/Walmart/Target + EU MediaMarkt/Fnac/Otto

Market frame. Euromonitor: global robot-vac sales CAGR 18.97% 2011–21 → $5.854B in 2021 (+14.47%); units 2.14M→15.61M (CAGR 21.97%). iRobot filings: $0.945B→$3.394B 2014–20 (CAGR 23.75%); China largest (¥4.4B→¥10.1B 2017–21); EMEA #2 (>20% 5yr). Penetration still <15% in US/DE/JP 2021; China 4.39%. Forecasts: global/China ~$13B/$5B by 2025 (Zhongyan). Two tech leaps: random→global planning navigation; self-clean/self-empty bases. Price rises with tech; cost control = volume enabler. Global ecom $5.5T (2022) → >$7T by 2025 (~23.6% of consumer spend).

Feb 2023 commerce (12 markets). Mid/small brands flooded Amazon; list-price bands stable — $150–350 ~40%; $350–550 and $550+ ~20% each. Sweden no SKUs <$150; NL none <$70; MX ~20.61% <$70, US ~17.73%. Target no <$150; BestBuy/MediaMarkt/OTTO no <$70. Same SKU usually cheapest on Amazon, dearest on BestBuy (Roomba 694, Roborock S7 MaxV Ultra).

Reviews (11 markets): ~67.9% positive / 24% negative; avg 3.8 — Italy/CA/BE/DE/FR/NL ~4.2; US 3.6 (~31% negative).

US chapter. iRobot MS −31.57pp (promo end); Shark +5.05pp → #3; newcomer OKP 7.58% #4; Bissell/ILIFE/Yeedi/ZCWA +7.66% combined. Top10: Eufy RoboVac XS overtakes iRobot #1 (iRobot still 5/10 SKUs); OKP <$100 into #3; Roborock exits; Shark AV1002AE replaces AV2501AE. $70–150 band 3.92%→17.47% (+13.5pp) on OKP pressure on premium. Cross-platform: Roomba 694 Walmart $259.99 vs Target $179.99 (−$80); Roomba j7+ (7550) Walmart $799 vs BestBuy $599 (−$200). User topics: hair / suction / cleaning top-3; Amazon weights obstacle avoidance; BestBuy cleaning frequency; Walmart suction. Scenes: floor / room / setup — BestBuy 100% positive on object avoidance; iRobot users overweight quiet + frequency but complain hair/suction; Eufy strong on hair praise; Shark highest obstacle-avoidance attention.

Germany chapter (brand share, SKUs, price bands, feature/scene) in CN images — attach on ingest (adtarg).

— END —
